authorization: Author requested frozen HR/HRV agreement, both datasets, existing event-output baselines
rem: formal_ablation_20261027 A4 selected.json, seed_base42 (actual42+fold), identical SHA256 to main-table/clinical manifest
baselines: five adapted dual-head main-table checkpoints; reuse full-precision soft-refined R anchors from completed baseline_clinical_20261101 cache, checking checkpoint hashes
segment_grid: [0,12000),[12000,24000),... per recording; discard incomplete tail, count/report it separately; both R endpoints must be inside same segment
stitch: Full native8s windows, prediction-only nearest-window-center ownership. Interior boundaries are midpoints of adjacent window centers; half-open, ties go to later window. First/last window cover own start/end. Clip each owned region to its native1600-sample support. No GT matching, no offset correction, no template assembly. Fully uncovered signal time makes segment unavailable, separately reported.
reference: Frozen record-level raw_reference event_r at200Hz (NeuroKit2 reference ECG R peaks), same references as clinical evaluation; validate stored hashes
correction: Non-iterative. Raw consecutive RR; physiologic keep iff0.3<=RR<=2.0. Local median of original indices i-2:i+3 inclusive current, ignoring nonphysiologic values, truncated at recording ends. Drop iff absolute relative deviation>0.20. No interpolation and no GT-assisted correction. Evaluate per-segment fraction of retained original RR.
eligibility: Require >=80% raw RR retained for EACH signal; >=2 retained RR for SDNN/RMSSD. Summary uses paired intersection. No additional detection/matching/quality threshold. Pred/ref independent discard flags and counts retained.
metrics: HR=60/mean(retained RR); SDNN=sample std(retained RR)*1000; RMSSD=sqrt(mean(diff(retained RR)^2))*1000, adjacent entries of retained sequence, no synthetic RR or interpolation. Metrics are60s short-segment estimates, not long-term HRV.
aggregation: Individual paired segments pooled per dataset/method/metric for MAE,bias,Pearson r. Repeated LoA from unchanged shared.repeated_loa: one-way unequal-count ANOVA within+between subject variance; bias +/-1.96sqrt(total). Also report counts, subject count, prediction/reference removals, individual/paired discard rates; missing/no-data is never zero error.
output: docs/paper/hrv_agreement_20261103; append numeric tables and producing commit/script to docs/paper/RESULTS_MANIFEST.md
